style: English, warm piano pop, expressive female voice, acoustic piano, rounded bass and light drums, lyrical memorable melody, unhurried phrasing, 96 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Neon fades along the lane
Footsteps keep the time of rain
Fold the night and leave it here
Morning has a sky to clear

[Pre-Chorus]
And the quiet starts to lift
Every hour a little gift

[Chorus]
Let the day come into view
Every road begins with you
Hold a little room for light
We will sing beyond the night

[Verse]
Window glass and coffee steam
Nothing here is what it seems
Paper boats along the drain
Summer leaning on the pane

[Pre-Chorus]
And the quiet starts to lift
Every hour a little gift

[Chorus]
Let the day come into view
Every road begins with you
Hold a little room for light
We will sing beyond the night

[Bridge]
If the morning runs away
If the colours turn to grey
Keep the melody you know
Let it carry you back home

[Chorus]
Let the day come into view
Every road begins with you
Hold a little room for light
We will sing beyond the night

[Outro]
We will sing beyond the night
Sing beyond the night
